queries.query: Thanh Hoa Vietnam official cadastral parcel map land database GIS
queries.result: Found the official Thanh Hóa provincial portal and an official national public-service listing for provincial land-data provision. The search did not identify an anonymous parcel geometry viewer or public parcel API for Thanh Hóa.

queries.query: Thanh Hóa bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: Found official Thanh Hóa legal/procedural material and the provincial online public-service portal. The evidence establishes a provincial land-data and cadastral custodian/procedure, but not anonymous parcel geometry access.

registry.custodian: Sở Nông nghiệp và Môi trường Thanh Hóa / Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai Thanh Hóa
registry.evidence: The official national service listing names the Thanh Hóa provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment receiving unit and provides a provincial online address for the procedure 'Thủ tục cung cấp dữ liệu đất đai (cấp tỉnh)'. Official Thanh Hóa reporting describes the provincial land database and cadastral-map work.
registry.scope: Provincial land-data service and cadastral administration; city-level parcel coverage and anonymous geometry access were not demonstrated.
